meta.name: odoo-data-quality-gate
meta.description: Audit an Odoo database's data quality with evidence before trusting AI answers, importing, or migrating — duplicates, missing required values, orphaned references, format anomalies — and drive remediation through odoo-mcp's gated write workflow. Use when the user asks to "check data quality", "clean up data", "prepare for migration", "find duplicates", or when aggregate answers look suspicious.

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 Odoo 数据库的数据质量问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 Odoo 并担心数据质量影响 AI 回答或迁移结果。
